text:
Noah: Drafting the release notes + internal announce for v1.14.0. This includes a conditional DB migration that will run a small backfill. Requesting pin + comms cadence.
Ivy: Suggest midday low-traffic window 12:30 PT. Canary 12:00, ramp 12:30. Keep canary small (2-4%).
Carlos: migration touches hot partition; recommend canary at 2% + a 20m observation hold before ramp. Also request snapshot backup at T-30m.
Noah: pin to artifact hash f9e8d7c to allow exact rollback if needed. Deploybot, please set pin and schedule jobs.
deploybot: @Noah pin applied: f9e8d7c. Canary 2% scheduled at 1718230800 (12:00 PT). Ramp scheduled at 1718232600 (12:30 PT).
Ivy: rollback criteria proposal: sustained p95 latency +200ms for 10m OR error-rate >2% for 5m OR DB write errors >0.5% for 5m. If any trigger -> rollback.
Carlos: also add replication lag >25s for 5m as immediate rollback trigger. Ops will watch via dashboard panel "db-hot-table".
Noah: ops announce plan: T-45m to #eng-oncall with runbook link and exact CLI; T-15m to #eng for heads-up; T+1h company note if any visible impacts. Who will post?
Ivy: I can post T-45m ops note. Carlos can do the T-15m. Noah will send the company note if needed.
Ally (Legal): quick review: migration diff shows no export or PII changes. Legal clear.
Carlos: ops rollback CLI snippet for the runbook:
```
# rollback example
releasesctl rollback --to f9e8d7c-previous --reason "migration_anomaly"
```
Noah: add a short FAQ in internal note: what is a pin? meaning and where to find it in Console. Also mention artifact retention for pinned builds (7 days).
deploybot: Note: artifact retention for pin f9e8d7c set to 7 days. Backup snapshot scheduled at 1718230500 (11:45 PT). Canary heartbeat: 60s.
Ivy: please call out manual rollback contacts in the ops note (Carlos, Ivy, Noah) and include a single-line escalation path.
Noah: good call. I'll include rollback playbook link and one-liner escalation. Also mark the release note doc as "ops-review" once Ivy posts the ops snippet.
Carlos: I'm on standby for the window. Will enable query sample capture during warmup.
Ivy: final confirm: pin set, canary 2%, hold 20m, backup scheduled, rollback criteria documented, runbook link included, T-45m ops post.
Noah: thanks all. Closing this draft 1m until ops post. Will flip to "announce-ready" after T-45m post.
